planets.name: GJ 3473 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of GJ 3473 with a 1.2-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: GJ 3473 b was found in 2020 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around GJ 3473. Its orbit and size follow Kemmer et al. 2020's fit, the archive's default.
